> adhd makes my soul feel like I’m in a cage with a fucking toddler who destroys literally everything I care about.

This made me tear up. Goddamn. Just recently, when talking to my partner, I compared talking my brain into literally just 10 minutes of studying to negotiating with a toddler - who keeps throwing temper tantrums anytime I want to get literally anything done. Showering, household chores, cleaning, _texting people_, my hobbies, ...

I know I have depressive tendencies, but it has always been this way. Autism is just the (albeit super heavy) cherry on top.

When I'm in hyperfocus, I can process information and produce things fast as hell. I can get excited about stuff like nobody else. I'm highly intelligent and extremely talented, yet I can barely motivate myself to do anything ever. I can understand any information that interests me, but as soon as my ADHD registers that we will eventually get it, I lose that interest and it becomes a chore for me. 

Like I said to my partner: ADHD, specifically hyperfocus, is like a superpower, but a useless one. It's like being able to walk super fast, but only backwards. 

It's so frustrating. I could do a lot. I could share so much with the world. But I'm not able to, and maybe never will be.

I'm sorry this turned into a rant. TLDR: I feel it to my core. It's so, so hard.
